((खाद्य पदार्थों को मुँह में लेकर चबाना और निगल जाना या खाना)) • **"Eight"** refers to the number 8 (आठ (अंक)), while **"ate"** is the past tense of the verb **"eat."** • Homophones can be tricky because they sound the same, so it's important to pay attention to the context and spelling of the word to determine its meaning. • The correct answer is Option 3.
